Write a Node.js script at `/home/user/airdrop.js` that reads `/home/user/recipients.json` and uses the Crossmint Minting REST API to attempt to mint a "Welcome NFT" to each recipient on `polygon-amoy`.

   * `results`: an array of objects, each with `email` (the address) and `status` (`"sent"` on HTTP 200/202, `"error"` otherwise) and optionally `response` (the raw API response body)

Handle per-recipient errors gracefully — if one mint fails, continue processing the rest.
